changes.place: L12, first raised mark on f
changes.scan_shows: A compact filled raised spot stands separately to the right of f. It has no visible open centre or detached prime shaft.
changes.mathematical_consequence: Records the visible raised point; the H dot and our bullet have the same established ink referent.

changes.place: L12, first Picard-name capital
changes.scan_shows: The P has displaced overlapping body and stem strokes. Their separation does not settle an intended doubled alphabet versus a repeated plain P impression.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The alphabet of the first Picard-name P remains explicitly unresolved.

changes.place: L12, target Picard subscript
changes.scan_shows: A short, separate oblique stroke stands at the upper right of the lowered X, before the longer slash. It is distinct from both the X serif and the slash.

evidence.detail: This short stroke was noticed in the existing formula crop and is also present in the already-created context of crop 05; no further crop was made for it.

changes.mathematical_consequence: The proposed target subscript is X prime/S.

changes.place: L13, v under the handwritten s in have/has

changes.place: L13, cancelled final e of have
changes.scan_shows: A separate e follows the corrected v position and is crossed by a dense oblique handwritten stroke.

changes.place: L15, terminal cancelled letter of morphisme
changes.scan_shows: A terminal character is overtyped with an x. Curved residue supports e, but its full body is not separable from the cancellation.

changes.place: L16, lower typed layer under f_*
changes.scan_shows: A lower closed loop and typed body remain beneath the taller handwritten f; g is still tentative. The handwritten f and its lower star are live.

changes.place: L16, pair of horizontal strokes before h
changes.scan_shows: The upper stroke has a right-facing head. The lower stroke ends in a rounded thickening whose separate arrowhead arms are not recoverable.
changes.mathematical_consequence: Retains both a two-arrow reading and an upper arrow above an unheaded bar; no exactness argument was used to choose the glyph.

changes.place: L16, lower mark on h
changes.scan_shows: Several short rays meet below h: a left descending arm, a lower stroke, and a rightward arm are visible. A complete star cannot be separated from an upward-arrow shape.
changes.mathematical_consequence: The lower mark on h is left unresolved; it was not selected from the expected notation.

evidence.detail: This row concerns only the gap before the question mark; the word-reading uncertainty is recorded separately.

changes.place: L17, terminal e in homomorphisme
changes.scan_shows: The crossed terminal character retains an e-shaped curved body and middle bar under the angular x overtype.

changes.place: L18, final s of the theorem morphisms
changes.scan_shows: The final s has a dark angular superposed impression and intersecting diagonal traces within its contour. Cancellation leads the reading, but the separation from a displaced repeated impression remains incomplete.
changes.mathematical_consequence: Preserves the cancelled/live alternatives for the final s, affecting the live singular/plural wording.

changes.place: L18, uncertain e position in specifically
changes.scan_shows: Between the heavy p impression and the clear c there is a pale character-width position; no complete e is independently recoverable. The reading retains e and a blank position.

evidence.detail: The space after the alternative separator in the proposed macro denotes the visibly vacant/faint position, not an expansion or a corrected spelling.

changes.place: L18, cancelled word before in

changes.place: L19, raised mark after factorisation of

changes.mathematical_consequence: Retains the visible open raised mark at this particular occurrence.

changes.place: L19, f-label/via boundary

evidence.detail: The exact witness suffix fragments isolate spacing; the raised-symbol reading is counted in the preceding row only.

changes.scan_shows: Letter bodies and ascenders support as you know, followed by a partly obscured both. Typewritten x cancellation covers the spaces and several letter interiors; the whole proposed phrase remains tentative.

notes.summary: The page continues a typed letter discussing the n.th-power homomorphism and explaining the author’s interest in a proof method involving non flat descent. The author introduces a theorem concerning Picard functors, follows it with Corollary 1, and begins a final factorisation sentence. The handwritten changes include a restricted existence-problem phrase, a finite direct sums of insertion, and a query beside the underlined replacement-of-S clause. This describes the page and does not certify its claims.
